ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized at the lower margins and scattered as punctate clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are mapped along the lower left margin and the distal right tip. Numerous small, circular, high-contrast white ring-blobs are distributed throughout the central dark pigmented areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 85 degrees and a vertical pixel depth roughly 20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness with deep, non-uniform indentations toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve; the trailing edges follow an overall concave sweep trajectory heavily modulated by high-frequency topographic irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) across the entire dark surface, consistent with barnacle scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, protruding three-dimensional cluster of stalked barnacles is attached to the distal tip of the left lobe. The distal trailing edge of the right lobe shows significant irregular tissue loss and trauma-induced jaggedness.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme barnacle colonization on the left fluke tip serves as a highly unique macro-level visual marker.
